newsitem.title: UK: Norwich extends insurance deal with Barclays.
newsitem.headline: Norwich extends insurance deal with Barclays.

text.p: UK insurer Norwich Union Plc said on Monday that it is extending its contract with Barclays Plc as a preferred supplier of personal general insurance products for the British banking group for a further 5-1/2 years.
Barclays said in a joint statement that under the agreement, Norwich will be its preferred supplier of insurance products and a related claims service.
The relationships between the insurer and the banking group was established in March 1996.
"Our aim is now to broaden the range of quality products available to our customers," said Bob Drench, managing director of Barclays insurance services.
